structured_output.explanation: No contract drift detected. Schema is identical (same 10 columns, order, dtypes, 50000 rows, 0 duplicates). Formats stable: order_date is YYYY-MM-DD x50000 both days; unit_price/amount fixed at 2 decimals, discount_pct at 1 decimal. Value vocabularies unchanged: status = {pending, delivered, shipped, cancelled}, discount_pct = 4 values in 0-15, customer_name 224-name pool, email shape/length constant. Magnitudes are within sampling noise (unit_price mean 452.08->451.00, amount 2260.86->2247.58, quantity 5.00->4.99, all <1%), and the row invariant amount = quantity * unit_price holds exactly on every sample row both days. email null rate 1.88%->1.97% (~45 rows) is not a surge. The 59,895-byte file growth is fully explained by order_id widening from 4-5 digits to 6 digits across 50000 rows; no hidden column or encoding corruption (string length ranges unchanged). The order_id/customer_id range shifts and the small order_date window slide are expected day-over-day identifier/temporal movement, explicitly not drift.
